newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy 38,000/T Mar 11-30 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy 38,000/T Mar 11-30 fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy one 38,000-tonne cargo of 0.5 percent sulphur fuel oil for March delivery, a company official said on Wednesday.
CPC seeks to buy a low pour point cargo for delivery March 11-30 to Keelung, Kaohsiung or Shenao, the official said.
The tender closes February 12 and is valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought two 38,000-tonne cargoes at between $135-$138 per tonne on a cost-and-freight basis.
